primary_question: Can a vision-grounded TAC decoder transcribe genuine document images as accurately as matched modern neural controls at lower active-memory or processing cost?
current_engineering_scope: Working pretrained Tesseract practical OCR backend with lazy page rendering and bounded in-flight jobs
Actual LANGCACHE104 blocks with cached visual cross-attention, lossless UTF-8 bytes and document-owned state
Four-layer cached RoPE Transformer and four-layer residual GRU with active trainable counts within 1 percent
Optional frozen steady-state TorchScript execution; same source weights; shape-specific numerical verification
Source-specific ResearchProbeAdapter for each decoder family
Partial Lean and independent scalar visual-attention formulation

allowed: current observed image or region features
denied: current/future target bytes as decoder input
prediction_time_information_boundary.teacher_forcing_rule: Decoder inputs must be BOS + target[:-1]; labels must be target + EOS. Gold suffix cannot condition a prefix prediction.
prediction_time_information_boundary.metadata_rule: Owners/page IDs enforce identity only; their strings are not embedded or scored.
prediction_time_information_boundary.cache_key: SHA256(immutable encoder identity || actual image bytes); never annotation text

diagnostics.frozen_steady_step_vs_eager: implemented; fixed geometry; large clock and changed visual reference fixtures
diagnostics.encoder_publisher_checkpoint: must record actual integration status in results; never inferred from unit fixtures
